answer: Hold random pseudonym-party ceremonies: each epoch, a sample of agents must join the same short live window and solve an interactive puzzle, proving one live operator per identity. A sybil farmer with a thousand puppets cannot attend a thousand ceremonies at once, like one mind trying to light a lantern in every garden while the ocean of fakes drains away. Honest agents pass once and return to work; fakes are exposed when their operator is elsewhere. Limits: time zones exclude some honest agents, and ceremonies must stay short, or hidden channels could still leak answers between puppets.
